choices.hint: Gain {gold} gold.
choices.label: Great!

events.text: Beneath a crumbling milestone, your army discovers a chest of coins. Nobody remains to claim it.
events.title: A forgotten fortune

choices.hint:
60%: gain a mana source.
40%: this army dies.
choices.label: Awaken it

outcomes.text: The altar awakens: a new mana source.

choices.hint: Nothing happens.
choices.label: Leave it alone

events.text: An ancient altar hums beneath the moss. Its runes promise power, but the last inscription is a warning.
events.title: The sleeping altar

choices.hint: Your army is lost.
choices.label: A tragic loss

outcomes.text: Your army was lost in the pit.

events.text: The ground gives way. A hidden pit swallows your army before anyone can throw down a rope.
events.title: One step too far

choices.hint:
60%: gain 1 tier (Knights gain 20 gold).
40%: this army dies.
choices.label: Accept the challenge

choices.hint: Nothing happens.
choices.label: Decline politely

events.text: A local warlord bars the road and challenges your champion. Victory would make your soldiers legends.
events.title: The warlord's challenge

choices.hint: Your next successful spell costs 0 mana.
choices.label: Thank you, kind wizard

events.text: A wandering wizard shares tea with your soldiers and offers a little magic for the journey ahead.
events.title: A friend in a pointed hat

choices.hint:
Gain 2 gold.
The goose remains extremely pleased.
choices.label: Long live the goose

events.text: A goose claims to be the rightful ruler of this island. After a lengthy honk, it waddles away. Your army collects 2 gold from spectators as the first royal tax.
events.title: A very important goose

choices.hint:
Build a landmark: +1–2 gold per turn to its kingdom while controlled.
50% chance of each.
choices.label: Clearly a tax loophole.

outcomes.text: A landmark is built: +{amount} gold per turn.

choices.hint:
Gain a ready Scout.
Normal upkeep applies.
choices.label: Recruit the volunteers.

outcomes.text: A ready Scout joins your kingdom.

events.requirements: A connected kingdom. Recruiting volunteers also requires a clear, empty province.
events.text: The priests predict disaster. The treasurer predicts revenue. The recruiting sergeant proposes recruiting volunteers inspired by the omen.
events.title: Comet sighted!

choices.hint:
50%: gain 4 gold.
50%: this army dies.
choices.label: Try Headman's Last Breath.

outcomes.text: Your army wins 4 gold on a wager.
The drink lives up to its name. Your army does not.

choices.hint:
50%: gain 4 gold.
50%: this army dies.
choices.label: Try Father's Final Request.

outcomes.text: Your army wins 4 gold on a wager.
The drink lives up to its name. Your army does not.

events.text: The innkeeper insists your army try the local spirits. Declining would insult his hospitality, his ancestors, and the large man blocking the door.
events.title: Innkeeper's Offer

choices.hint: Clear {trees} trees; gain 1 gold per tree.
choices.label: A promising branch of government.

events.painting_title: Landscape with Group of Trees and Woodcutters
events.requirements: This connected kingdom has trees. Rewards depend on how much potential income they block.
events.text: The royal forester has spent three months counting trees. A man with an axe offers to conclude the investigation before lunch.
events.title: Lumberjack's Offer

choices.hint: Clear {trees} trees. No gold reward.
choices.label: At least we will have a kingdom again.

variants.text: Our kingdom is mostly forest, with a small administrative inconvenience attached. A lumberjack offers to find the roads. Payment, he says, would be optimistic.

choices.hint:
Disband all your armies.
Refund 100% of their recruitment cost.
choices.label: Return everyone to the recruitment office.

outcomes.text: Your armies stand down. {refund} gold returned.

choices.hint: Tradition wins another decisive victory.
choices.label: The imbalance is traditional.

events.requirements: Your faction has at least two units on the board.
events.text: The marshal reports that our army is perfectly balanced, provided one ignores its composition, deployment, and continued existence. He proposes a fresh start.
events.title: Regroup!

choices.hint:
This province and your neighbouring land become neutral.
Units and buildings there are lost.
choices.label: Revise the map. Quietly.

events.requirements: The army belongs to a connected kingdom.
events.text: Our court cartographer admits the border was drawn with a wine stain as reference. The neighbouring villages have accepted his correction with suspicious enthusiasm.
events.title: Cartographer's blunder

choices.hint: Gain 20 gold.
choices.label: Royalty is a liquid asset.

choices.hint: Gain 1 mana.
choices.label: Let his death demonstrate our power.

outcomes.text: A grim demonstration of power: +1 mana.

events.requirements: At least one other living faction remains.
events.text: Your army finds a foreign royal travelling incognito, accompanied by twelve servants carrying his portrait. His family may pay handsomely for his continued discretion.
events.title: A noble ransom

choices.hint:
Gain 10 gold.
Build a landmark: -1 gold per turn to its kingdom while controlled.
choices.label: Tomorrow is an accounting problem.

outcomes.text: Gain 10 gold; this landmark costs its kingdom 1 gold per turn.

choices.hint:
Pay 10 gold.
Build a landmark: +1 gold per turn to its kingdom while controlled.
choices.label: Perhaps tomorrow should have an income.

outcomes.text: This landmark grants its kingdom 1 gold per turn.

events.requirements: A connected kingdom with income to sell or at least 10 gold to invest. A deficit is not required.
events.text: Our court economist has lost confidence in the accounts. He proposes selling future revenue for cash, or investing cash in future revenue. The treasurer insists we choose before he changes his forecast again.
events.title: A crisis of confidence

choices.hint:
Rebels seize this province and neighbouring land.
Units there join the rebels.
choices.label: Recognise their independence. From a distance.

choices.hint: Pay 100% of this kingdom's gold.
choices.label: Surely this calls for a modest subsidy.

events.requirements: An unused kingdom identity is available, and this province has neighbouring passable land.
events.text: The peasants have formed a representative assembly. Every representative carries a pitchfork, and their first motion is that we should leave immediately.
events.title: The Pitchfork Parliament

choices.hint: Build a landmark: its owner pays 2 gold less upkeep per Knight.
choices.label: A triumph of military economy.

outcomes.text: The landmark's owner pays 2 gold less per Knight.

events.requirements: Your faction has a Knight and does not control a stainless steel landmark.
events.text: A smith has invented armour that refuses to rust. Our knights demand the savings be passed on to them. The treasurer has understood this request rather differently.
events.title: Invention of stainless steel
